methodological_rigor.justification: This is a comprehensive IND-enabling preclinical development package for IBI334, a B7-H3/EGFR bispecific antibody. The work spans: bioinformatics and IHC co-expression analysis of EGFR and B7-H3 across solid tumors, BLI affinity/kinetics measurement of multiple B7-H3 and EGFR binders, epitope binning, extensive cell line panel (>40 lines) for cytotoxicity (CellTiter-Glo 2D/3D) and ADCC (Jurkat reporter and PBMC-LDH), EGFR internalization and occupancy assays, phospho-EGFR imaging, Western blot of downstream signaling (AKT/ERK/S6), cryo-EM structure determination of 4Ig-B7-H3-20G5 F(ab')2 complex at 3.59 A and B7-H3-20G5 Fab at 2.98 A resolution (5,017 movies, cryoSPARC pipeline), drug synergy with KRAS inhibitors (SynergyFinder+), multiple xenograft models (SK-MES-1, NCI-H292, NCI-H1975, NCI-H508, NCI-H358, NCI-H322SVD, A431, SK-MES-1LTC, NCI-H1975LTC), cynomolgus monkey PK (n=18, 3 dose groups) and GLP toxicology study (n=40, 4 dose groups up to 120 mg/kg weekly x 4 weeks plus 4-week recovery), and ultimately IND/phase 1 registration (NCT05774873). Blinding is explicitly stated for in vivo efficacy and monkey studies. Statistical rigor uses ANOVA with Tukey post-hoc and appropriate SD/SEM reporting; explicit multiplicity correction across the large xenograft panel is not detailed.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: A preclinical drug-development package that has enabled IND and a registered phase 1 clinical trial (NCT05774873) in advanced/metastatic solid tumors; Oxford LoE 5 for preclinical but clinical relevance is practice-changing-adjacent given the known dose-limiting toxicities of EGFR-targeting agents (acneiform rash, severe GI toxicity). The B7-H3-mediated cis-inhibition concept for tumor-selective EGFR blockade could inform a new class of tumor-selective bispecifics.

reporting_quality.justification: ARRIVE applies. IACUC approvals (Innovent internal and West China-Frontier PharmaTech A2022147-T014-01), animal housing parameters (22+/-2 C, 50+/-5% humidity, 12:12 light cycle), humane endpoints (>2000 mm^3 tumor volume or >20% body weight loss), and randomization at 120-220 mm^3 tumor volume are documented. Blinding of investigators to group assignment is explicitly stated. NHP GLP study reports doses, schedule, cytokines (IL-2/6/10, TNFa, IFNg), hematology instruments (ADVIA 2120i, Cobas 8000, LSRFortessa), histopathology sampling at dose-end and recovery-end (6 + 4 animals per group). Cryo-EM parameters are thorough (pixel size 0.743 A, dose 55 e-/A^2, cryoSPARC v4.4.0). Data-deposition (PDB/EMDB accession) is not referenced in the excerpt, a notable omission for structural work.

novelty_literature.justification: The concept of B7-H3/EGFR bispecific with cis-inhibition to achieve tumor selectivity is novel and specifically formalized here. Prior bispecific EGFR approaches (Amivantamab) do not exploit a tumor-selective co-receptor; B7-H3 is broadly tumor-overexpressed with low normal-tissue expression, making cis-inhibition a mechanistically attractive strategy. The cryo-EM structure identifying critical residues for the 20G5-B7-H3 interaction adds structural novelty. The synergy with KRAS inhibitors (AMG510/MRTX133/LY3009120) is a combination extension. Overall a meaningful, IND-track innovation rather than a first-in-class target.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is well organized across mechanism, structure, pharmacology, safety, and combination. Methods are extensive with explicit reagent catalog numbers, software versions, formulas, and procedural parameters. The abstract cleanly summarizes the translational path (NCT05774873). Minor issues include a formula typo ('where 5 represents the percentage') in the EGFR occupancy section and some dense multi-experiment methods.

key_strengths: Full IND-enabling package: mechanism (B7-H3-mediated cis-inhibition of EGFR), cryo-EM structure (2.98 A and 3.59 A), extensive xenograft efficacy, NHP PK (n=18) and 4-week GLP toxicology (n=40) with no EGFR-related AEs up to 120 mg/kg
Large cell-line panel for cross-tumor selectivity and demonstrated synergy with KRAS inhibitors (AMG510, MRTX133, LY3009120) for combination rationale
Clinical translation achieved: IBI334 is registered in phase 1 trial NCT05774873
In vivo studies appropriately blinded and randomized; explicit NHP humane endpoints and safety assessments (cytokines, hematology, histopathology)
key_concerns: Data deposition for cryo-EM (PDB/EMDB accession) is not visible in the methods excerpt
Minor formula typo in the EGFR occupancy assay description reduces clarity of receptor occupancy calculation
Xenograft experiments span many models without explicit multiplicity correction for the efficacy panel
4-week NHP toxicology is standard IND-enabling but chronic tolerability remains to be established
chief_reviewer.rationale: An IND-enabling, structurally resolved preclinical package with an actionable tumor-selective mechanism already advancing to phase 1; top-tier plausible (Nature Cancer / Nature Communications onc) with minor revisions on data deposition and assay description clarity.
